what: Annotate plan references oos_issue_stdout without defining it
scenario_or_breakage: In step5b_annotate_main the --issue-stdout-file argument is built from oos_issue_stdout but the plan never binds it to design_tmpdir / "oos-issue.stdout.txt" (skills/design/scripts/design-step5b-annotate.sh:91). An implementer can NameError or pass the wrong path so ISSUES_FAILED detection and annotate I/O diverge from Bash.
suggested_fix: Add oos_issue_stdout = design_tmpdir / "oos-issue.stdout.txt" immediately after the tmpdir guard and pass str(oos_issue_stdout) to file_oos_annotate_main and to the ISSUES_FAILED grep on failure.
